review.tagline: Agent skill that turns a video URL or file into timestamped frames and transcript
review.summary: Watch is a skill/plugin for Claude Code, Codex and other Agent Skills hosts. It converts a video URL or local file into timestamped frames and a transcript, using native captions first and optional WhisperX, Groq or OpenAI transcription otherwise. With a GEMINI_API_KEY it can instead send the video to Gemini and relay the timestamped answer.
review.audience: Claude Code and Codex users who want agents to analyze video
strengths: Installs as a plugin in Claude Code or as a skill in Codex and other hosts
Local engine works without an API key, using ffmpeg and yt-dlp
Frame detail levels, caps, start/end ranges and cue timestamps are configurable
Captions are used first; WhisperX, Groq or OpenAI only as fallback
weaknesses: Does not work in Claude Chat or Cowork
Requires Python 3.10+, FFmpeg and current yt-dlp installed separately
YouTube also needs a JavaScript runtime such as Deno
WhisperX is verified only on Apple Silicon; other platforms untested
needs: Needs Python 3.10+, FFmpeg, yt-dlp, Deno (YouTube), WhisperX 3.8.6 (optional), Node.js (Skills CLI install only)
Models: Gemini (gemini-3.7-flash default), WhisperX, Groq whisper-large-v3, OpenAI whisper-1
